menus.title: Celestia Mesh
menus.subtitle: Capability-bound commands between trusted Celestia Nova instances

sections.title: Remote Command
sections.description: Targets and commands are resolved from verified ContentForge content. Nova ID authentication is mandatory.

fields.label: Trusted Target
fields.description: A content-defined Mesh target ID; arbitrary hosts are never accepted.

fields.label: Allowed Command
fields.description: An allowlisted command ID, for example node.status.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The local command receipt; tokens and command payloads are never displayed.

fields.label: Send Command
fields.description: Queues an authenticated request without blocking Canvas.

fields.label: Refresh Receipt
fields.description: Shows the local status of the selected receipt.
